prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System = Regional Flow Platform (Cedarbell); creates initial TOBT proposal from flight intent, stand readiness, turnaround progress, capacity constraints. Airports Meridian International, Harbor East, North Valley, Lakeside Regional, Southport keep safety authority. Parts: Demand Prediction Service (Marlinstone; flags TOBTs causing runway/sector imbalance; refreshes stand forecasts on off-block change); Capacity Assessment Module (CAM; constraints only, no safety judgments); Slot Allocation Engine (Blueharbor; matches demand to CAM constraints using FIM, Airport Capacity Plan, Airport Acceptance Rate, runway metering, sector loading; under GDP derives CTT within capacity envelope; recalculates opportunities); Airport CDM Portal (Foxglove; Common Situation Display; publishes slot results); Arrival Regulation Console (arrival opportunities: capacity source, regulation start, expected delay); Departure Metering Service (departure opportunities/CTT to Tower Sequence Manager); Ramp Movement Board (apron constraints; updates to Audit Event Ledger); Contingency Operations Console; Time Synchronization Service (timestamps allocation runs into Audit Event Ledger); Weather Ingest Gateway (WIG, Orchard; time-stamped weather updates); Business Rules Registry (BRR; versioned exemption categories, priority codes, fairness metrics); Collaborative Decision Log; Performance Analytics Warehouse (post-event equity assessment); Airline Interface Adapter (advisory preferences); Surface Surveillance Adapter (evidence only); Digital Briefing Room; Flight Data Exchange; Alert Distribution Hub; Identity Access Service; North/South Runway Meter; Sector Load Monitor; Gate Conflict Detector; Handling Resource Planner. Actors: Regional Flow Manager (Copperfin; priority policy; approves shorter cycles); Slot Coordinator (runs allocation; logs exemptions with rule, approving role, consequence); Airline Operations Coordinator (Saffron; delay slip exemption requests); Aircraft Operator Representative; Ground Handling Dispatcher; Ramp Control Lead (Quartzline; Stand Tow Request Form); Tower Supervisor (Brindle; confirms pushback; may reject departure opportunities); Airport Duty Manager; Meteorology Briefing Officer; Data Governance Steward; System Support Engineer. Items: TOBT, CTT, delay slip, Tactical Regulation Proposal, GDP status, Storm Cell Snapshot, Runway Inspection Note, Post Operations Report, duty coordination alert, Slot Compliance State. Modes: Normal Operations (regular refresh); Adverse Weather Mode, Recovery Phase (shorter cycles); Capacity Reduction State (Copperfin may change rules); Contingency Fallback State (last valid allocation kept, manual amendments,

New part:
S252: The Capacity Assessment Module applies the active Airport Capacity Plan and Airport Acceptance Rate to determine whether the proposed demand pattern remains operationally feasible.
S253: The Slot Allocation Engine derives the Calculated Takeoff Time by combining runway metering constraints, departure fix loading, and applicable Ground Delay Program rules.
S254: The Tower Sequence Manager maintains the tactical runway sequence expectation and highlights cases where the Calculated Takeoff Time is inconsistent with the local departure order.
S255: The Ramp Movement Board maintains milestone timestamps for stand readiness, boarding completion, doors closed, start approval readiness, taxi start, and other locally configured departure events.
S256: The Time Synchronization Service provides the reference clock for all target time calculations so that negotiation records and operational timestamps can be compared without local clock ambiguity.
S257: For voice coordination, Halcyon is the operational call sign used by the Slot Coordinator during daily target time conferences.
S258: The Slot Coordinator reviews proposed Calculated Takeoff Time values against network constraints and requests adjustment when the allocation would create avoidable delay or unfair sequencing.
S259: The Airline Operations Coordinator reviews the proposed Target Off Block Time against aircraft readiness, crew availability, passenger connection risk, and operator recovery priorities.
S260: Saffron shall confirm any operator-requested Target Off Block Time revision in the Airport CDM Portal before the freeze horizon expires.
S261: The Ground Handling Dispatcher updates handling milestones when service completion forecasts change, and those updates are treated as negotiation inputs until the freeze point is reached.
S262: The Ramp Control Lead assesses whether the proposed off-block pattern is compatible with apron access, stand conflicts, and local movement restrictions.
S263: The Tower Supervisor may challenge a proposed Calculated Takeoff Time when runway configuration, wake spacing, or local sequencing conditions make the value operationally unsuitable.
S264: The Airport CDM Portal presents each proposed value with its confidence status, last update time, and the reason code assigned by the proposing function or authorized user.
S265: The Common Situation Display shows the current agreed target set so that operational participants can see whether a flight is proposed, under negotiation, frozen, or exempted from compliance monitoring.
S266: Negotiation remains collaborative while the value is outside the freeze horizon, and each accepted amendment replaces the prior value as the current shared plan.
S267: The Collaborative Decision Log records each challenge, counterproposal, acceptance, rejection, and reason code associated with the Target Off Block Time and Calculated Takeoff Time.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
